name: Cthulhu o Asobu Koe
original_name: クトゥルフをあそぶこえ
source:
The story is simple, the protagonist, Kousaka, a transfer student is invited to enter a club by one of his classmate Miko, the theology club.

But this is only a facade, the club in question is actually Miko along with Izumi another classmate and a senior Nina playing Call of CTHULHU.

[From [url=https://hadlerblog.wordpress.com/2016/07/02/the-hegemony-of-free-games-pt1/]Hadler's review[/url]]
translation:
故事很简单，转校生主角高坂被同学巫女邀请进入神学社。

但这只是表面现象，所讨论的俱乐部实际上是Miko和另一位同学Izumi以及学长Nina一起玩《克苏鲁的呼唤》。

[来自[url=https://hadlerblog.wordpress.com/2016/07/02/the-hegemony-of-free-games-pt1/]Hadler的评论[/url]]
